name: Sunray Aurora 300SH | 2-4-Person Traditional Barrel Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Aurora 2–4 Person Barrel Sauna is a spacious retreat designed for comfort and relaxation. Measuring 5' deep by 6' wide, it provides seating for up to 4 people or extra bench space to stretch out. Built from sturdy 1 3/8" thick cedar lumber with ball-and-socket construction and stainless steel hardware, it is designed for durability indoors or outdoors. Equipped with a powerful 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater, the Aurora heats quickly to 170–180°F and includes a built-in delay timer so you can schedule your sauna session up to 8 hours in advance. Features like a shingled roof, ergonomic backrests, tempered glass, dome lighting, and a complete accessory kit make this sauna a versatile and stylish addition to your backyard or home.
